script.source: String s = doc['path'].size() > 0 ? doc['path'].value : '-'; s = s.replace('\\', '/').replace('"', "'"); s = /\p{Cntrl}/.matcher(s).replaceAll(' '); return s.length() > 70 ? s.substring(0, 70) + '...' : s;

String x = doc.containsKey('x_forwarded_for') && doc['x_forwarded_for'].size() > 0 ? doc['x_forwarded_for'].value : '-'; String c = doc.containsKey('client_ip') && doc['client_ip'].size() > 0 ? doc['client_ip'].value : '?'; if (x != '-' && x != '') { String[] hops = x.splitOnToken(','); String ip = hops[hops.length - 1].trim(); if (!/^[0-9a-fA-F:.]{3,45}$/.matcher(ip).matches() || !(ip.contains('.') || ip.contains(':'))) { return 'internet (bad XFF)'; } if (hops.length == 1 && ip == '173.48.155.66') { return 'your own devices (173.48.155.66)'; } return hops.length == 1 ? 'internet ' + ip : 'internet ' + ip + ' (client-set XFF, ' + hops.length + ' hops)'; } if (c.startsWith('192.168.') || c.startsWith('10.') || /^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[01])\./.matcher(c).find() || c.startsWith('127.')) { return 'LAN client ' + c; } return 'internet ' + c + ' (no XFF: hit the origin directly)';

ui_metadata.description: More than 5 nginx 5xx in 5 min (Home Assistant 502/504 excluded: Uptime Kuma owns it). Priority 2 instead of 5 when a real container restarted in the last 10 min.
